HMLR_GML_EXPORT_GEOJSON
QGIS can export the GML layer to GeoJSON.
HMLR_GML_CAPTURED_BNG
HM Land Registry polygon data is captured against British National Grid.
HMLR_GML_REPROJECT_SHIFT
The guidance warns that BNG-to-WGS84 conversion can shift some features by up to 15 metres.
